blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `refundPayment` method. This belongs to the Payment Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method refunds a payment using its associated payment provider. An amount can only be refunded if it has been captured first.
